text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from shopping with Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. The raffle is over here.
How many tickets do we have again?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: A one-shot deal, huh? Nice, that gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you mind if I give it a try?
Just to test my luck.
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
—Excuse me, one round, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow eagerly
turned the lottery wheel's handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? Haha, alright!
Lady Luck seems to be on our side!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, high five♪
Yeah, yeah!
My mood's popping off and in top gear!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, a hot spring, huh...
I can't go just yet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Taking it easy isn't a bad thing, but now's really not the time.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If I let my guard down and accidentally let someone take the lead...
No, just thinking about it is infuriating!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer-san!
Could you hold on to the tickets for me?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Once things settle down, let's go together.
...Maybe to celebrate making your dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that she might enjoy it more if she went with friends.
For example, with her childhood friends—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a pair of tickets, I can only invite one person.
And if that's the case, that person has
to be you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Where the Big Four assemble is on the turf.
That is absolute.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So if we are to talk together
about the dream we've reached—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: First off, it just has to be Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's eyes look to the sky,
toward the place she will someday reach.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it. I wonder what we'll be talking and laughing about when that time comes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those simple words seemed to contain not just the hot springs,
but the journey toward her most cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'd say that's pretty decent.
Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It doesn't look like there's enough for everyone to eat... And the included sauce is... spicy tomato sauce?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No... That's a shame.
I'm really not good with spicy food.
It makes my tongue go all numb.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can eat this.
Trainer, if you'd like to—
choice_data_list: Shall I whip up some teriyaki sauce?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You will, Trainer?
...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then let me make yours, Trainer.
Just tell me what you like, and I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. You meant its shape, not its taste?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine with that, but cute, huh...
Trainer, are you sure you're not just
trying to cater to my tastes?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah? In that case, might as well enjoy myself!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's cute. These cats and bears
are so well-made too... it almost feels like a waste
to eat them.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're really good at this too, Trainer.
To make such a huge hamburg steak,
and shaped like a character, no less—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Was that your first challenge, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Getting the chance to try out various things.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: An opportunity to take on a challenge?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right!
Blowing bubble gum was your first time trying it too, right, Trainer? How nostalgic~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It might be something small, but you remembered.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's nothing you need to thank me for.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Going by that logic...
maybe I'm the one who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because I get to cheer on your first challenge
from the absolute closest spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hamburger steak we made together, and the special carrot hamburger steak I won.
Both left truly unforgettable flavors.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the 2nd prize! That's a huge amount.
Piled up like this, it looks so impressive.
choice_data_list: I'll give it all to you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'd feel bad taking all that.
Can't we at least split it half and half?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, half was still too much for me alone.
I thought it might be better if she just took all of it... but.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Tell ya what, let's do this.
I'll make something out of this,
and you can have half of whatever I make.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll make carrot cake.
A super sweet one!
Maybe I'll put in double the usual sugar♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding!
I'll make sure to prepare yours separately, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mind if I go buy a few more ingredients?
I'll deliver it tomorrow.
The finest carrot cake you've ever had.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, dig in!
Even if I say so myself, it turned out great.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still, making just cake left us with extra carrots. So as you can see, I went ahead and made other things too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Carrot chips, carrot cookies,
carrot jam, carrot macarons,
and then carrot ice cream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A line of sweets laid out across the table.
It seems they made them less sweet, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is a masterpiece!
Don't be shy, dig right in♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow gave a carefree laugh. Making this many while adjusting the sugar amounts must have been quite an ordeal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the sugar in each one is low,
eating this much all at once is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I resolved in my heart to run my absolute hardest
during today's training as well...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hmm, third prize, huh. As far as luck goes...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But that's just today's fortune!
Tomorrow, your luck's bound to change.
For the better, of course!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we got a carrot out of it.
What are you going to use it for, Trainer?
Since there's only one... maybe veggie sticks?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure?
It feels kind of bad for me to be the only one getting one, though."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, then how about we do this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the park with Bubble Gum Fellow.
She washed the carrot she received, snapped it in half,
handed one piece to me, and—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Holding up the carrot
as if it were a champagne glass."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the meal.
It might've been a while since I last munched on a whole carrot like that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, don't rush, take your time eating.
I don't mind waiting at all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. The wind feels so nice.
It's been a while since we had such a peaceful moment.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If it's to make my dream come true, of course I will.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"To take the lead in a race,
one cannot afford to look back
or stop in their track—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...... Ah, maybe that's why.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When it's not a race, at least,
I want to wait for Trainer-san
like this.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Because you're always waiting for me
ahead at the finish line, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Bubble Gum Fellow
smiled just a little mischievously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling somewhat embarrassed, she stuffed the rest of the carrot into her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Aw, bummer.
Guess my luck just wasn't cutting it today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Tissues won't go to waste, but...
Yeah, it's still pretty disappointing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It can't be helped. I'll try again next time.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I hope I win next time, the hot springs trip...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stuffing the received tissues into my pocket,
I returned to the academy with Bubble Gum Fellow...
